newsitem.title: USA: Disney says Pfeifer leaves record label.
newsitem.headline: Disney says Pfeifer leaves record label.

text.p: Walt Disney Co. said Thursday that Bob Pfeifer resigned as president of its Hollywood Records unit to pursue the creative side of the music business.
Richard Leher, executive vice president of Hollywood'''';;;; Records, will assume Pfeifer's duties for the time being.

Pfeifer joined Hollywood Records in 1993 as vice president of artists and repertoire for the label, which has been struggling becaue of a lack of hits and management turnover. He was named president in March 1995.
"I started as a musician, and it's time for me to get back to more creative, and less administrative, pursuits," he said.
Disney's stock rose 50 cents to $76.125 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
